sfpe-handbook.title: SFPE Handbook of Fire Protection Engineering, 5th ed. — mass-loss rates and radiative fractions of burning polymers
sfpe-handbook.note: Free-burning mass-loss rate near 0.02 kg/m2s and a radiative fraction near 0.3 for charring polymers. Mid-range values: a real fire depends on ventilation, orientation and sample thickness, none of which the engine models.

nec-310-16.title: NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, Table 310.16 — allowable ampacities of insulated conductors in raceway, cable or earth, 30 °C ambient
nec-310-16.note: Source of the raceway ampacity column, which the engine carries for reference only: the thermal model solves one conductor in still air, which is Table 310.17's geometry.

nec-310-17.title: NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, Table 310.17 — allowable ampacities of single insulated conductors in free air, 30 °C ambient
nec-310-17.note: This is the geometry the engine models: one conductor, still air. Validation compares the solved conductor temperature against the insulation rating at this current.

nec-ch9-t8.title: NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, Chapter 9 Table 8 — conductor properties (area, DC resistance of uncoated copper)
nec-ch9-t8.note: Source of conductor cross-sectional areas and overall conductor diameters. The table's DC resistance column is deliberately not read: resistance is computed from the metal, which makes that column a comparison instead.

nec-ch9-t5.title: NFPA 70 National Electrical Code, Chapter 9 Table 5 — dimensions of insulated conductors (THHN/THWN-2)

crc-handbook.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 97th ed. — electrical resistivity and temperature coefficients of the elements
crc-handbook.note: Copper and aluminium resistivity, temperature coefficient and density. Tungsten has its own key, crc-tungsten, because the filament needs the resistivity over a 2500 K range rather than one value at room temperature.

crc-tungsten.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics — resistivity of tungsten from 300 K to 3000 K; Y. S. Touloukian, Thermophysical Properties of Matter, Vol. 1
crc-tungsten.note: Power-law exponent 1.2 reproduces the tabulated ratio rho(2800 K)/rho(293 K) ~ 15 to within a few percent.

incropera.title: Incropera, DeWitt, Bergman & Lavine, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th ed. — Table A.4 (air properties), Ch. 7 (external forced convection), Ch. 9 (free convection)
incropera.note: Air transport properties at 300 K and their temperature trends; flat-plate forced convection correlation.

churchill-chu.title: Churchill & Chu, 'Correlating equations for laminar and turbulent free convection from a vertical plate' and '... from a horizontal cylinder', Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 18 (1975)
churchill-chu.note: Natural convection Nusselt correlations used for every ambient surface.

si-constants.title: BIPM SI Brochure, 9th ed. (2019) and CODATA 2018 recommended values
si-constants.note: Stefan-Boltzmann constant, Boltzmann constant, elementary charge. Solar constant 1361 W/m2 per Kopp & Lean (2011).

vlach-singhal.title: Vlach & Singhal, Computer Methods for Circuit Analysis and Design, 2nd ed. — modified nodal analysis, damped Newton, GMIN
vlach-singhal.note: Solver formulation, convergence criteria and the node-to-ground leakage convention.

victron-phoenix-1200.title: Victron Energy Phoenix Inverter 12/1200 VE.Direct datasheet
victron-phoenix-1200.note: 1000 W continuous at 25 C, 2400 W peak, 8 W no-load, 92 % peak efficiency, 9.3 V shutdown / 10.9 V restart, 17 V high-voltage cutoff.

victron-multiplus.title: Victron Energy MultiPlus 48/3000/35 datasheet
victron-multiplus.note: 2400 W continuous at 25 C, 6000 W peak, 20 W no-load, 95 % peak efficiency, 37.2 V shutdown / 43.2 V restart, 66 V high-voltage cutoff, output derates above 25 C.

victron-mppt-100-50.title: Victron Energy SmartSolar MPPT 100/50 datasheet
victron-mppt-100-50.note: 50 A maximum charge current, 100 V maximum PV open-circuit voltage, 98 % peak efficiency, ~10 mA self consumption, temperature-compensated absorption/float.

battleborn-bb10012.title: Battle Born Batteries BB10012 (12.8 V 100 Ah LiFePO4) specification sheet

lfp-cycle-life.note: Capacity fade per equivalent full cycle.

canadian-solar-cs6k-300ms.title: Canadian Solar CS6K-300MS (60-cell monocrystalline) datasheet
canadian-solar-cs6k-300ms.note: 300 W, Vmp 32.5 V, Imp 9.24 A, Voc 39.7 V, Isc 9.83 A, NOCT 43 C, temperature coefficients, 1650 x 992 x 35 mm, 18.2 kg, three bypass diodes.

renogy-100d.title: Renogy 100 W 12 V monocrystalline panel (RNG-100D) datasheet
renogy-100d.note: 100 W, Vmp 20.4 V, Imp 4.91 A, Voc 24.3 V, Isc 5.21 A, 36 cells, 1130 x 505 x 35 mm, 6.4 kg.

esram-chapman.note: Perturb-and-observe step sizes and tracking behaviour.

bird-hulstrom-1981.title: Bird & Hulstrom, 'A simplified clear sky model for direct and diffuse insolation on horizontal surfaces', SERI/TR-642-761 (1981)

nrel-nsrdb-denver.note: Annual mean GHI near 5.3 kWh/m2/day. Horizontal irradiance is the cleanest test of the sun position, clear-sky and cloud models together, because no array orientation enters it.

nrel-denver-yield.title: NREL PVWatts v6 run for Denver, CO (39.74 N, 104.98 W), 1 kWdc fixed open rack, 40 degree tilt, 180 degree azimuth, 14 % system losses
nrel-denver-yield.note: Annual specific yield near 1650 kWh/kWdc. Recorded here as the comparison figure for validation/cases/dailyYield.js; the tolerance band is wide because the engine uses a clear-sky model with a synthetic cloud series rather than a TMY file.

anl-fuse-curve.title: Blue Sea Systems / Littelfuse ANL-series time-current characteristic curves
anl-fuse-curve.note: Digitised points at 1.35x, 2x, 3x, 5x and 10x rated current.

atc-fuse-curve.title: Littelfuse ATO/ATC blade fuse time-current characteristic curves
atc-fuse-curve.note: Digitised points at 1.35x, 2x, 3x, 5x and 10x rated current.

ul489.title: UL 489 calibration requirements for moulded-case circuit breakers and the Square D QO series time-current curves
ul489.note: Must-hold at 100 %, must-trip within one hour at 135 %, plus the published thermal band and instantaneous magnetic region.

bluesea-187.title: Blue Sea Systems 187-series thermal DC circuit breaker time-current curve
bluesea-187.note: Panel-mount DC breaker used for battery and controller branches.

bluesea-9001.title: Blue Sea Systems m-Series 9001 battery switch and 2105 busbar specifications
bluesea-9001.note: 300 A make-and-break rating, contact resistance, and busbar rating.

ge-lamp-handbook.title: GE Lighting, Incandescent Lamps (TP-110) and Lamp and Ballast Product Catalog
ge-lamp-handbook.note: General-service lamps run a colour temperature of 2700-2900 K, near 2850 K at 100 W, which is a true filament temperature around 2700 degC; cold-to-hot resistance ratio near 15; and the spectral split between visible transmission and infrared absorption in soda-lime glass.

energystar-fridge.title: ENERGY STAR certified residential refrigerator product data and the DOE test procedure (10 CFR 430 subpart B appendix A)
energystar-fridge.note: Compressor input power, run-time fraction and locked-rotor inrush multiple for a small top-freezer unit.

nichrome-properties.title: Kanthal / Sandvik Nikrothal 80 (Ni80Cr20) resistance alloy datasheet
nichrome-properties.note: Resistivity, temperature coefficient and density of the heating element alloy.

matweb-materials.title: MatWeb material property data for soda-lime glass, ABS, rigid PVC, mild steel and monocrystalline silicon PV laminate
matweb-materials.note: Density, specific heat, thermal conductivity and emissivity of enclosure and insulation materials.

pvc-ignition.title: Babrauskas, Ignition Handbook (2003) — auto-ignition temperature of rigid and plasticised PVC; NFPA Fire Protection Handbook
pvc-ignition.note: PVC softens near 105 C, chars near 250 C and auto-ignites near 450 C. Heat of combustion near 20 MJ/kg.

secop-bd35f.title: Secop (formerly Danfoss) BD35F 12/24 V DC compressor technical data and Vitrifrigo/Isotherm 12 V fridge product data
secop-bd35f.note: 12 V DC variable-speed compressor, 45 W typical running input at 2000 rpm, 10.4 V low-voltage cut-out with a 11.7 V restart, locked-rotor current about 5 times running current for under half a second.

shurflo-4008.title: Pentair Shurflo 4008-101-E65 12 V DC diaphragm pump datasheet
shurflo-4008.note: 3.0 gpm at 45 psi, 7.5 A at 12 V nominal, internal bypass so input power is nearly independent of head.

dc-immersion-heater.title: Kanthal Nikrothal 80 element data (ref:nichrome-properties) applied to a 12 V DC immersion heating element
dc-immersion-heater.note: A bare resistance element has no electronics, so its current is set only by the alloy's resistivity at temperature. Used as the reference resistive DC load.

noaa-denver-normals.title: NOAA NCEI 1991-2020 US Climate Normals, Denver International Airport, CO (USW00003017)
noaa-denver-normals.note: Monthly mean temperature -0.4 C in January and 23.6 C in July; mean diurnal range near 15 C year round.

dc-led-strip.title: 12 V DC LED tape lighting circuit, generic
dc-led-strip.note: A 12 V LED tape runs its diodes in strings of three behind a series resistor, so over its operating range the current follows the resistor rather than the diodes and the circuit measures as a resistance. Used as the small resistive DC load: cabin lighting is what an off-grid pack runs overnight.

aeternasol-200w-bifacial.title: AeternaSol 200 W bifacial N-type monocrystalline 12 V module - retail product listing
aeternasol-200w-bifacial.note: A marketplace listing, not a datasheet. It states 200 W, bifacial N-type cells with 18 busbars, 12 V nominal system voltage, an IP68 junction box, and 25 % efficiency. It publishes no Vmp, Imp, Voc, Isc, temperature coefficients, dimensions or mass, so the current-voltage curve here is a 36-cell N-type module scaled to the 200 W rating. The 25 % is a cell figure, not a module one: 200 W at 25 % module efficiency would be a 0.80 m2 module, which no commercial module reaches, while production N-type TOPCon cells do reach 25 %. Area is taken from the 1480 x 690 mm outline standard for a 200 W 12 V panel, which makes this module 19.6 % efficient. The engine has no rear-side irradiance term, so the bifacial gain the panel is sold for is not modelled and it runs as a monofacial 200 W module.

generic-48v-2500w-inverter.title: 48 V 2,500 W pure sine wave inverter with 110 V AC output - retail product listing
generic-48v-2500w-inverter.note: A marketplace listing: 2,500 W continuous, 5,000 W peak, 48 V DC input, 110 V 60 Hz pure sine output, four AC outlets, USB and Type-C ports, and an adjustable low-voltage cutoff for lithium packs. No efficiency curve, no-load draw, trip threshold, time at peak power, mass or case size is published. Those follow the low-cost high-frequency class, which sits several efficiency points below a transformer-isolated unit such as ref:victron-multiplus and holds an overload for seconds rather than minutes.

temgo-48v-100ah.title: TEMGO 48 V 100 Ah LiFePO4 golf cart battery - retail product listing
temgo-48v-100ah.note: A marketplace listing: 51.2 V 100 Ah (16 cells in series, 5.12 kWh), a BMS rated 200 A continuous with a 600 A peak, low-temperature charge protection, an IP65 enclosure, LCD and Bluetooth monitoring, and a supplied 56.8 V 18 A charger, which is 3.55 V per cell at full charge. Cell-level curves, internal resistance, the charge current limit and the duration of the 600 A peak are not published; they come from the LiFePO4 references, which is defensible because this is the same chemistry in the same series count as the rack pack.

generic-100a-mppt.title: 100 A MPPT solar charge controller, 12/24/36/48 V - retail product listing
generic-100a-mppt.note: A marketplace listing: 100 A charge current, automatic 12/24/36/48 V battery detection, an LCD, dual USB outlets, seven battery-type modes, and maximum power point tracking claimed. It states no PV input voltage ceiling, no efficiency, no self-consumption and no charge set points. Tracking behaviour and the charge profile follow ref:esram-chapman and ref:victron-mppt-100-50; efficiency and self-consumption are estimated for the class.

simulation.ambientTemperatureCSource: assumption:default indoor ambient; overridden by the environment model or the UI
simulation.metersPerGridSpaceSource: assumption:editor scale, one 24 px grid square is 10 cm of conductor

solver.source: assumption:tolerances follow the SPICE convergence defaults documented in ref:vlach-singhal (VNTOL 1 uV, RELTOL 1e-3, ABSTOL 1 pA), tightened where the extra precision is achievable; 1 uV and 1 nA are orders of magnitude below anything measurable in a solar installation
solver.maxVoltageStepSource: assumption:junction voltage limiting per ref:vlach-singhal section 6.4. Without a trust region an early Newton step can throw a node hundreds of volts past any junction, where a linear-continued exponential contributes a conductance around 1e19 S and the matrix loses all its other entries to cancellation. 10 V per iteration is far larger than any junction's forward range and still reaches a 100 V array within the iteration limit
solver.stagnantIterationSource: assumption:once KCL holds to currentAbsToleranceAmps and five further Newton steps fail to improve the residual, the remaining motion is floating-point rounding in the stiffest equation of the system rather than physics

integrator.source: assumption:step-size limits chosen so the fastest modelled state changes by a small fraction per step

conservation.source: assumption:relative tolerance for the per-step energy and charge balance checks

site.arrayOrientationSource: ref:nrel-denver-yield fixed open rack at 40 degree tilt facing due south; individual panels may override it
site.indoorTemperatureSource: assumption:an unheated but enclosed space such as a garage or utility room, used for equipment marked as installed indoors. Real installations put the pack inside precisely because a lithium pack cannot be charged below freezing

fire.source: ref:sfpe-handbook for the free-burning mass-loss rate and the radiative fraction; estimate:the flame radius and flame temperature are the geometric reach and gas temperature used for spread between adjacent devices

weather.source: assumption:synthetic but deterministic cloud series; shape follows ref:pvwatts-v5
weather.annualTemperatureSource: ref:noaa-denver-normals monthly means run from -0.4 C in January to 23.6 C in July, which is an annual mean of 11.6 C and a half-amplitude of 12.0 C
weather.coldestDaySource: ref:noaa-denver-normals coldest daily normal falls in the second week of January
weather.dailySwingSource: ref:noaa-denver-normals mean diurnal range, the difference between the average daily maximum and minimum, is close to 15 C in every month

copper.emissivitySource: estimate:oxidised copper surface, 0.6; polished copper would be 0.05 and is not representative of installed conductors

tungsten.emissivitySource: ref:crc-tungsten total hemispherical emissivity of tungsten near 2800 K

soda-lime-glass.infraredAbsorptanceSource: ref:ge-lamp-handbook fraction of filament radiation absorbed by the envelope; the visible and near-infrared balance is transmitted

abs-plastic.ignitionSource: estimate:ABS auto-ignition of 416 C and heat of combustion of 36 MJ/kg from the companion tables of ref:pvc-ignition, whose measurements are for PVC; ABS is a different polymer and this is an extrapolation across the two

air.exponentSource: derived:power-law fits to ref:incropera Table A.4 between 250 K and 800 K

electrical.chargeBlockedResistanceSource: estimate:with the charge MOSFET off, the only path taking current into the pack is the BMS's own voltage sense and cell balancing network. A few milliamps across a 13 V pack puts it in the tens of kilohms; 10 kOhm is that order and makes the blocked branch carry milliamps rather than nothing
electrical.contactorResistanceSource: estimate:BMS MOSFET bank on-state resistance for a 100 A drop-in pack

limits.overCurrentTripCurveSource: estimate:BMS overcurrent response inferred from the datasheet continuous and surge ratings
limits.protectionResponseSource: estimate:a MOSFET BMS needs tens of milliseconds to detect a voltage or temperature excursion and open the pack, consistent with the surge tolerance of ref:battleborn-bb10012. It is deliberately slower than a fuse clearing a bolted fault, which is why the fuse wins that race.
limits.reconnectDelaySource: estimate:BMS lockout before reclosing the contactor, so a sagging pack cannot chatter
limits.chargeResumeSource: estimate:the BMS terminates charge when a cell reaches its over-voltage limit, which in this model is the top of the state-of-charge range, and lets it resume once the pack has given a couple of percent back. 2 % is the order of the reclose window on drop-in packs and keeps a full pack from cycling its charge FET
limits.chargeLowTemperatureSource: ref:battleborn-bb10012 blocks charging below 0 C to prevent lithium plating; the 5 C reclose is estimated hysteresis so a pack warming through freezing does not chatter
limits.damageTemperatureSource: ref:lfp-thermal-runaway separator melt begins well below the self-heating onset

electrical.idleDrawSource: derived:10 mA self consumption at a 12 V battery, ref:victron-mppt-100-50
electrical.inputBleedSource: estimate:every controller measures array voltage through a resistive divider across its PV input and bleeds the input capacitor through it; 100 kohm draws 0.4 mW at 65 V
electrical.outputBleedSource: estimate:the pack-voltage sense divider, the same order as the array one. It is what keeps the output rail defined when the pack stops accepting charge
electrical.efficiencyCurveSource: ref:victron-mppt-100-50 peak efficiency 98 %; the shape either side of the peak follows the published efficiency graph
electrical.inputRegulationBandSource: estimate:the input regulator has finite loop gain, so it holds its reference to within a band rather than exactly; 50 mV is the order of a hill-climbing tracker's error amplifier and is well below its 0.25 V tracking step
electrical.loopCurrentBandSource: estimate:the width of the handover between the tracking, stage-voltage and charge-current loops, as a fraction of the current at which they meet. A control loop's error band scales with its operating point, so 2 % holds from a milliamp at dusk to the 50 A rating; the floor keeps it defined at zero current
electrical.controlResistanceSource: estimate:small-signal input regulation stiffness of the tracking loop, chosen far below the array's dynamic resistance
electrical.outputRegulationSource: estimate:the load regulation window of the charge stage, about 1 % of a 14.4 V target. The controller tapers its duty cycle to zero across it, so in regulation the pack sits inside this band below the stage voltage
electrical.outputRegulationResistanceSource: estimate:output voltage regulation stiffness during absorption and float

tracking.maxIntegrationStepSource: derived:the tracker moves its reference by one stepVolts per call, so the integrator must call it often enough to follow the array. 60 s gives 1440 perturbations a day, worth 360 V of travel, against the roughly 10 V the maximum power point moves

electrical.idleDrawSource: estimate:LCD backlight and dual USB standby, five times the 0.3 W of ref:victron-mppt-100-50, which has neither

electrical.inputRegulationBandSource: estimate:the error band of a hill-climbing tracker's input regulator, held well below its 0.5 V perturbation step
electrical.loopCurrentBandSource: estimate:the width of the handover between the tracking, stage-voltage and charge-current loops as a fraction of the current where they meet, as on ref:victron-mppt-100-50; the floor keeps it defined at zero current
electrical.outputRegulationSource: estimate:about 1 % of the 57.6 V absorption target for a 48 V pack, the load regulation window the charge stage tapers across

components.name: 48 V 100 Ah LiFePO4 golf cart pack
components.description: Sixteen LiFePO4 cells in series behind a 200 A BMS, in a sealed golf cart case.

electrical.internalResistanceSource: derived:four times the 4S pack resistance for four times the series cell count, ref:lfp-internal-resistance
electrical.openCircuitVoltageCurveSource: ref:lfp-ocv-typical for the same sixteen cells in series; the supplied 56.8 V charger of ref:temgo-48v-100ah sits just above the top of this curve, which is what lets it push current into a full pack
electrical.capacityFadeSource: derived:20 % capacity loss over 3000 equivalent full cycles, ref:lfp-cycle-life
electrical.contactorResistanceSource: derived:a 200 A MOSFET bank carries about twice the die area of the 100 A rack pack's, so half its on-state resistance
electrical.chargeBlockedResistanceSource: estimate:with the charge MOSFET off, the only path into the pack is the BMS's own sense and balancing network, which is tens of kilohms

limits.overVoltageSource: derived:3.65 V per cell over sixteen cells, the standard LiFePO4 cell ceiling; the supplied 56.8 V charger stops below it
limits.underVoltageSource: derived:2.5 V per cell over sixteen cells, ref:lfp-ocv-typical
limits.chargeCurrentSource: estimate:the listing rates the BMS at 200 A discharge and states no charge limit; packs of this class hold charge to half the discharge rating, which the supplied 18 A charger stays well inside
limits.overCurrentTripCurveSource: derived:ref:temgo-48v-100ah rates 200 A continuous and a 600 A peak, which is the 3x point; the intermediate points are the shape a MOSFET BMS follows between the two
limits.highTemperatureSource: estimate:the cell manufacturer's discharge ceiling, the same as the rack pack of ref:battleborn-bb10012
limits.protectionResponseSource: estimate:a MOSFET BMS needs tens of milliseconds to detect an excursion and open the pack, which is deliberately slower than a fuse clearing a bolted fault
limits.reconnectDelaySource: estimate:BMS lockout before reclosing, so a sagging pack cannot chatter
limits.chargeLowTemperatureSource: ref:temgo-48v-100ah low-temperature protection blocks charging below freezing to prevent lithium plating; the 5 C reclose is estimated hysteresis
limits.chargeResumeSource: estimate:the BMS terminates charge at the cell over-voltage limit and resumes once the pack has given a couple of percent back, which keeps a full pack from cycling its charge FET

thermal.source: estimate:520 x 270 x 230 mm sealed case, exposed area excludes the base; conductance scaled from the 4S pack by cell count
